title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimized Trade Execution

claims.locator: Section 3, private state and actions, p.3
claims.interpretation: Private state is time/inventory; market state is queue-imbalance sign; actions reprice all remaining shares.
Empirical mean Bellman backups sweep remaining-time states from one to horizon; deadline forces market completion.

assumptions: Counterfactual transitions enumerate every private state and action on training quotes.
Low impact assumption: own actions do not change subsequent market events.
Reward is negative implementation shortfall with explicit reference fees and slippage.
deviations: Reduced L1/full-fill environment and three actions; does not reproduce millisecond NASDAQ partial-fill experiment.
Buy execution is mirrored from the paper sell example; one holdout episode contains a final settlement event.
Uses market-order urgency as third action, two passive offsets, and one imbalance-sign market feature.
mapping_review: Repository author mapping checked against cited source pages; anchors prove provenance, mathematical tests check implementation; external review remains independent.
